title: Fyrnock
description: Whether afraid of the light or allergic to it, few knew for sure, but Fyrnocks were ferocious quadrupeds with penetrating yellow eyes and sharp teeth. They would reproduce in great numbers and stick to the shadows with their young. In the cover of darkness, they were fierce and relentless predators, attacking en masse. Hera Syndulla and Sabine Wren encountered a colony of them on the Fort Anaxes asteroid.
